newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PacDun says hopes to improve margins.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PacDun says hopes to improve margins.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Pacific Dunlop said on Friday it aims to lift profit margins by two percent over two years.
"We see in the next two years that we need to lift our EBIT to sales margins by two percent," managing director Rod Chadwick told reporters.
The earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) to sales margin at the end of 1996 just under six percent.
Earlier, Pacific Dunlop reported a net loss of A$132.74 million for 1995/96 after abnormal losses of A$284.55 million, compared with a A$94.2 million net profit in 1994/95.
